title: Maharashtra's UCC drafting committee (headed by retired SC judge Ranjana Desai) takes public feedback on 37 questions (marriage age options 18/21/24/27, bigamy, live-in registration at start and end, common succession rules without a will; mostly yes/no/no comment plus written suggestions) via its website, email or post until 15 Nov 2026; CM Fadnavis aims for a UCC Bill in the December winter session; on 10 Nov Owaisi called it a 'Hindu Civil Code' imposed on non-Hindus and Fadnavis cited the Directive Principles
